title: Farm Machinery Safety Assessment
description: Free Farm Machinery Safety Assessment template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, daily checks, approval & sign-off.

Hazards And Controls

HazardWho / what is at riskExisting controlsLSRiskAdditional controls / owner
Tractor rolloverOperatorRollover protective structure (ROPS) and seat belt, slope limits, safe speed
Entangleme nt in PTO shafts and moving partsOperator, bystandersPTO guards in place, engine off before cleaning or adjusting
Crushing during hitching or under raised implementsOperatorLocks and supports, never work under unsu pported load
Runover and bystander injuryChildren, workersKeep people clear, rear visib ility, no passengers
Noise and vibrationOperatorCab, hearing pr otection, maintenanc e
Fire and fuel handlingOperatorNo smoking, fire extin guisher, safe refuelling

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Daily Checks

☐ Guards, shields and safety devices in place

☐ Brakes, steering, lights and horn work

☐ ROPS and seat belt in good condition

☐ Hydraulic leaks and tyre condition checked

☐ Operator trained and authorised for the machine

☐ Lock-out of power before maintenance
